consigna: Friday, spoken: talk for two minutes about a problem you had to sort out recently and what you asked for. Note two or three ideas first, then speak freely.
requisitos: Two pieces of advice you'd give someone in the same situation (week 42)
The problem, the effect and a clear request (week 45)
microtareas: *Mon (10 min).* Read your corrections from weeks 41 to 45. Write down the mistake marked most often, and one line on why it happens.
*Wed (5 min).* Write four sentences that avoid that mistake.
*Fri (5 min).* Record two minutes. Then listen and mark the mistake.
autochequeo: Were all three requirements really there?
Did the complaint include a request, not just annoyance?
Was the advice usable, or too vague?
promptCorreccion: This is a review of three skills at B1 level: opinion with a reason, giving advice, and complaining with a clear request. (1) For each, say whether it is present and whether it is done well. (2) Tell me which one broke down under time pressure. (3) Give me one sentence that carries two of them at once. Correct nothing outside these three areas. ---
